national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – portal: impots.gouv.fr; professional VAT portal: gérer la TVA within impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign SARL must obtain French SIREN/SIRET identifiers from INSEE via the INPI/CFE one-stop shop. For VAT, the entity must apply to DGFiP for a French intra-community VAT number (n° TVA intracommunautaire). If no French permanent establishment, a tax representative accredited by DGFiP may be required. Application file: exterior proof of legal existence, articles of association, identity documents, expected French turnover, and optionally a compliance mandate for non-EU residents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Default: separate corporate income tax (IS) registration for the SARL. Small SARLs may elect pass-through taxation where receipts are taxed in the hands of the associates under CGI Art. 239 bis AA. No general US-style check-the-box election; France applies limited elections, including option for territorial extension, group integration (intégration fiscale) and branch permanent-establishment protection.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For EU-established taxable persons: 91,900 EUR annual turnover excluding VAT for sales of goods or 37,500 EUR for taxable services (2025 franchise de base). For non-EU or foreign SARL without French nexus: no threshold, VAT registration is mandatory as soon as the first taxable supply occurs in France or the reverse charge applies to imported services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: E-invoicing and e-reporting reform under Loi de Finances implementing the EU ViDA framework. Mandatory acceptance of structured electronic invoices via a registered PDP (Platforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire) or the public Chorus Pro portal for all B2B transactions established in France: mandatory issuance from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-size enterprises, from 1 September 2027 for small/medium enterprises. E-reporting of cross-border and domestic transaction data via API connection to DGFiP or certified platforms; no per-transaction real-time fiscal stamping is required for goods exports, but export substantiation documents must be retained and submitted upon audit demand.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.zero_rating_statutory_basis: CGI Art. 262-1-I (export of tangible goods outside the EU), Art. 262-1-II (transport-and-loading services), Art. 269-II-2 and BF-UAC 2024 tax doctrine for direct export documentation.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.reverse_charge_note: Offshore B2B services supplied to non-EU customers are generally subject to place-of-supply rules in the customer's jurisdiction and are outside the scope of French VAT, requiring no French export zero-rating but systematic evidence of the customer's economic establishment and the intra-group cross-border flow.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of botulinum toxin formulations qualify for French 0% VAT when (1) the goods are physically shipped to a destination outside the EU; (2) transport begins and is completed within 12 months of the sale; (3) the seller holds objective evidence of exportation; (4) the goods are not consumed or diverted within the EU. For services strictly ancillary to exported goods (loading, quality inspection, cold-chain transport to the frontier), zero-rating is also available. B2B services rendered to non-EU contract research organizations are not zero-rated export services but follow the place-of-supply rules (outside France, therefore not subject to VAT).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DAU/EXS electronic export summary declaration and movement reference number)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR consignment note (with exporter's identity and destination)
Commercial invoice (signed, itemized, stating HS code 3002 or ISIC 2100 product category)
Packing list (with lot numbers, cold-chain labels, time-temperature data for biologics)
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT/telex bank credit confirming receipt from the foreign buyer
Certificate of non-EU customs entry or territoriality attestation when the first destination is an EU hub and final dispatch is to a third country
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP will require continuous reconciliation between export declarations, transport documents, and foreign-currency receipts. Inadequate documentation leads to immediate re-invoice of VAT at 20%, plus late-payment interest (intérêts de retard) at 0.2% per month and monetary penalties. A deliberate denial or misstatement of export evidence triggers the 40% bad-faith penalty (manquement délibéré) and an 80% penalty for dissimulation of taxable facts or abusive behavior (répression de l'abus de droit under CGI Art. 1729). Fraudulent zero-rating claims may also be prosecuted under CGI Art. 1741 with criminal fines up to €500,000 and imprisonment. Retrospective reassessment extends to 6 years for normal audit periods, and to 10 years when the taxpayer carried on a concealed activity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard 'impôt sur les sociétés' rate for fiscal years ending after 31 December 2023; a 15% reduced rate applies to the first EUR 42,500 of annual taxable profit for qualifying SMEs with turnover below EUR 10 million whose capital is at least 75% held by natural persons or independent SMEs; an additional 3.3% 'contribution sociale sur l'IS' applies where annual corporate tax exceeds EUR 763,000)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (crédit d'impôt recherche, CIR) at 30% on eligible R&D expenditure up to EUR 100 million then 5% above the cap; innovation tax credit (CII) at 20% on qualifying SME innovation costs; French patent box regime (article 238 CGI) taxing net qualifying income from patented botulinum toxin formulations at an effective 10% corporate rate, subject to accounting segregation and DEMPE substance conditions; 'jeune entreprise innovante' status may provide full exemption on taxable profit in the first three years and 50% relief for the following two years for qualifying innovative SMEs
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (no statutory expiry since the 2011 reform); annual offset of carried-forward losses is capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; optional one-year loss carryback (report en arrière) available with a EUR 1,000,000 ceiling producing a refundable credit paid over five years
